title: com.docker.sandbox/workload-identity@1
description: A per-sandbox workload identity minted by the runtime: a key the sandbox never holds, a committer its pushed commits are attributed to, and a ledger record of what it pushed. Singleton; presence is the request and every field is optional. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move.

trailers.description: How much of the identity each commit carries as trailers: full writes every identifier, short writes the sandbox id alone. Omit for the runtime's default.

ledger.description: What an unreachable ledger means at create: required refuses the sandbox, preferred creates it and registers once the ledger answers. Omit for the runtime's default.
